• Project details: the shutter turns green or blue as soon as you tap Commercial or Residential.
• Long-press Project on the camera: your last 5 projects (only ones still on the phone); one tap switches to it.
• The Residential / Commercial question after being away for an hour is gone: switch it in Project details.

• Caption suggestions come from your own Notes/Captions library.
